assumptions.referenceInsensitivity: Authored reference contains the simulated artifact but no additional preparation effect.
assumptions.sharedArtifact: Both independently seeded authored channels share the declared saturation-shaped artifact.
assumptions.stableGain: One gain within the declared bounds applies at all durations. The changing-gain control deliberately violates this assumption.

main.interpretation: The counterbalanced preparation contrast exceeds its three-standard-error screen after allowing for linear per-reading drift. The current-state-only law is challenged under that model. Nonlinear drift, carryover, hidden confounders and measurement provenance remain open.

reference.interpretation: After counterbalancing the measurement order, the preparation contrast does not clear the screening bound. An apparent unadjusted offset may be instrument drift. A smaller history effect cannot be excluded.
